## SDK Location
Primary SDK code lives in Termux (on-device, S26 Ultra) and the Agent-X GitHub repo.
The Agent-X/ folder in THIS project is a reference snapshot — top-level dirs (tekton-sdk/, quantum-membrain/, ava007-runtime/, onomondo-softsim-cli/) are empty placeholders here.

Not a peer Intellect. Gateway/execution suit for Cybernetic Ava007.
No military/combative/adversary terminology.
